title: Represent SBI VC Trade stablecoin support by token, chain and transfer direction

decisions.rule: At current capture, VCTRADE USDC and RLUSD are Ethereum-only. RLUSD's dedicated page says XRPL is planned but not live. Do not infer that native USDC/RLUSD on XRPL is supported by SBI retail custody.

Keep Circle-SBI USDC JV, SBI-Ripple RLUSD distribution, Circle-Ripple USDC/XRPL product cooperation, and SBI's historical Ripple equity stake as separate edges. No XRP demand without executed XRPL route/bridge data.
A network described as planned remains PLANNED until official activation and validated on-chain deposits/withdrawals are observed.

feature_admission: NONE. VCTRADE network support is operational context only. No SBI-linked XRP settlement, native XRP bridge volume or XRP demand is admitted.
